summary: Comprehensive architectural and implementation plan for building a private, secure Admin Panel (CMS Dashboard) at /admin for Anchorr Pranet Portfolio. Covers Supabase Auth restricted to pranetbhosale@gmail.com, Row Level Security (RLS) policies, database schema for events, gallery, videos, achievements, testimonials, about, services, settings, and contact inquiries, luxury black-and-gold admin interface with 12 management modules, multi-file image uploader with Supabase Storage, and fallback-tolerant live synchronization with the public portfolio.
